brief.title: Verify the run brief
brief.imperative: Confirm the run brief is present and complete: run/epic intent, project-customized templates (TEMPLATES_MANIFEST diff), model tiers used, artifact paths. If missing or incomplete, stop and report — do not audit blind.

logs.title: Audit the run log
logs.imperative: Read the ADMIRAL_LOG (or the Commander spine state for a non-fleet run). Extract candidates from RULINGs, INCIDENTs, ADMIRAL ERRORs, and recoveries: what was improvised, what was relearned, what a template or skill should have carried. Cite the log line for each.

feedback.title: Audit the feedback entries
feedback.imperative: Read the AGENT_FEEDBACK entries for this run/epic. Extract candidates from friction, adherence deviations, and improvement signals. Weight friction the run worked around over friction merely asserted.

crew.title: Audit crew workflow feedback
crew.imperative: Read every crew Workflow Feedback section (IMPLEMENTER_RESULT / REVIEW_RESULT). Consolidate phrase-different duplicates. Handoff gaps reported by multiple crews are the strongest handoff-scope candidates.

telemetry.title: Corroborate with engine telemetry
telemetry.imperative: Cross-check candidates against telemetry: rework_count per task, BLOCK verdicts, waives/forced overrides, re-dispatches, incident counts. Mark each candidate corroborated or assertion-only; raise confidence only with corroboration.

playbook.title: Reconcile against the existing playbook
playbook.imperative: Read .agent-work/LESSONS.md (Active). Map candidates to existing lessons: re-validations become confirm ops, contradictions become disconfirm ops, near-duplicates merge. Flag Active lessons this run's evidence undermines even if no one complained.

consolidate.title: Consolidate scoped candidates
consolidate.imperative: Produce LESSON_CANDIDATES from templates/LESSON_CANDIDATES.template.md: every candidate scoped, grounded, routed, confidence-rated; discard anything without a citation; include the ready-to-apply lessons-delta.json block for playbook ops. You nominate — do not apply anything.
